ShipModule.Name: Fed_Crystal_Armor_Med
ShipModule.Description: A crystalline laminate grown in the fabrication bays of the Utopia Planitia yards above Mars, with its atoms aligned along the line of the hull stress. The lattice vibrates at a resonant frequency, so a hit is spread through the crystal before it can crack. Good protection against explosions, some protection against kinetic rounds. Of the Starfleet ship plates of its size, it is the best protected against explosions and the best against armour-piercing rounds, but the costliest to build.
